AddDataCheckConfig.description_en: Creates or updates the table-level configuration of a data validation task to specify the tables to validate, the validation scope, and the comparison rules
AddDataCheckConfig.description_zh: 新建或更新数据校验任务的表明细配置，用于设定待校验表清单、校验范围与比对规则

AddDataCheckTask.description_en: Creates a data validation task with specified source and destination data sources, validation type, and scheduling mode
AddDataCheckTask.description_zh: 创建一个新的数据校验任务，指定源端与目标端数据源、校验类型及调度方式

AddDataCheckTemplate.description_en: Creates a data validation template that defines reusable comparison rules, which can be referenced by data validation nodes through the template ID
AddDataCheckTemplate.description_zh: 创建数据校验模板，定义可复用的比对规则，供数据校验任务按模板 ID 引用

AddMetaDataComponent.description_en: Creates a metadata data source and completes connectivity configuration. This is a prerequisite step for starting metadata discovery tasks. The create action does not require authentication, but the duplicate name check within it is authenticated
AddMetaDataComponent.description_zh: 新建元数据数据源并完成连通性配置，是启动元数据探查任务的前置步骤；新建动作无需鉴权，其中的重名校验已鉴权

CreateExecuteSqlConversion.description_en: Creates an SQL conversion task and immediately runs the conversion. Returns a task ID for subsequent queries on conversion progress and results
CreateExecuteSqlConversion.description_zh: 创建 SQL 转换任务并立即运行转换，返回任务 ID 供后续查询转换进度与结果

CreateSqlExecJob.description_en: Submits SQL conversion results in batch to the target for execution and returns the execution job information for this submission
CreateSqlExecJob.description_zh: 将 SQL 转换结果批量提交到目标端执行，返回本次提交的执行作业信息

DeleteDataCheckConfig.description_en: Deletes a specified data validation task configuration. After deletion, the configuration no longer participates in subsequent validation scheduling
DeleteDataCheckConfig.description_zh: 删除指定的校验任务表明细配置，删除后该配置不再参与后续校验调度

DeleteDataCheckTask.description_en: Performs a logical deletion of data validation tasks (batch operation supported). Deleted tasks are no longer displayed in the list or scheduled for execution
DeleteDataCheckTask.description_zh: 对数据校验任务执行逻辑删除（支持批量），删除后任务不再展示于列表且不再被调度

DeleteDataCheckTemplate.description_en: Batch deletes data validation templates along with their associated rule configurations and datasource engine relationships
DeleteDataCheckTemplate.description_zh: 批量删除数据校验模板，同时删除其关联的规则配置与数据源引擎关系

EditTaskPop.description_en: Edits the configuration of an existing SQL conversion task through the POP channel, such as the source dialect, target dialect, and conversion scope
EditTaskPop.description_zh: 通过 POP 通道编辑已存在的 SQL 转换任务配置，如源方言、目标方言与转换范围

ExecDataCheckDownloadReport.description_en: Exports the result details file at the subtask level by validation batch for offline verification of data differences
ExecDataCheckDownloadReport.description_zh: 按校验批次导出子任务级别的结果明细文件，用于线下核对差异数据

ExecDataCheckGenerateReport.description_en: Triggers report generation for a specified data validation batch. After generation is complete, you can query results through the report overview and details operations
ExecDataCheckGenerateReport.description_zh: 为指定校验批次触发报告生成，生成完成后可通过报告概览与明细接口查询结果

ExecDataCheckReRun.description_en: Reruns a completed data validation task to re-execute data comparison and generate a new validation batch
ExecDataCheckReRun.description_zh: 对已完成的校验任务发起重跑，重新执行数据比对并产生新的校验批次

ExecDataCheckRun.description_en: Triggers a data validation task immediately without waiting for timed scheduling
ExecDataCheckRun.description_zh: 不等待定时调度，立即触发一次数据校验任务执行

ExecDataCheckRunFailed.description_en: Reruns failed subtasks in a specified data validation batch, scoped by rerun type to avoid a full rerun
ExecDataCheckRunFailed.description_zh: 对指定校验批次中未通过的子任务发起重跑，按重跑类型限定范围，避免全量重跑

ExecDataCheckSaveTask.description_en: Saves one or more modified data validation tasks. You can also configure settings such as whether to perform full-table validation and whether to execute the task immediately
ExecDataCheckSaveTask.description_zh: 保存单个或批量修改后的数据校验任务，可同时调整是否整表校验、是否立即执行等开关

ExecDataCheckSqlPreview.description_en: Generates a preview of the comparison SQL that will be issued based on the check task configuration, allowing you to confirm the check scope before execution
ExecDataCheckSqlPreview.description_zh: 根据校验任务配置预览实际下发的比对 SQL，用于在执行前确认校验口径

ExecDataCheckStop.description_en: Stops the check node execution in the current scheduling run. Task results of completed subtasks are retained
ExecDataCheckStop.description_zh: 停止当次调度中的校验任务执行，已完成的子任务结果予以保留

ExecDataCheckToggle.description_en: Switches the timed scheduling toggle of a data validation task to control whether the task is periodically executed based on a Cron rule
ExecDataCheckToggle.description_zh: 切换数据校验任务的定时调度开关，控制其是否按 Cron 规则周期执行

ExecMetaDataComponentName.description_en: Checks whether a datasource with the specified name already exists under the current tenant. This operation is used as a pre-check before creating or renaming a datasource
ExecMetaDataComponentName.description_zh: 按数据源名称校验是否已存在同名数据源，用于新建或改名前的前置检查

ExecWorkflowConnectivity.description_en: Checks the connectivity of a storage data source used for schedule migration. You can submit a workflow migration task only after the connectivity check is passed
ExecWorkflowConnectivity.description_zh: 校验调度迁移所用存储数据源的连通性，连通性通过后方可提交工作流迁移任务

GetAllRulesSummary.description_en: 获取指定方言转换规则
GetAllRulesSummary.description_zh: 获取指定方言转换规则

GetBwmMigrationSubmitInstanceList.description_en: Queries the paging list of commit (write) instances for a scheduling migration node by node ID and status, and returns the transform and commit stage status of each instance
GetBwmMigrationSubmitInstanceList.description_zh: 按任务 ID 与状态分页查询调度迁移的提交（写入）实例列表，返回各实例的转换与提交阶段状态

GetBwmMigrationTaskWriterResultPackage.description_en: Exports the result package of a write task by instance ID for offline viewing of complete batch write results
GetBwmMigrationTaskWriterResultPackage.description_zh: 按实例 ID 导出写入任务的结果包，用于线下查看批量写入的完整结果

GetBwmMigrationTaskWriterWorkflowList.description_en: Performs a paged query on the details of workflows in a write (or publish) report by instance ID with paging. Supports filtering by workflow name
GetBwmMigrationTaskWriterWorkflowList.description_zh: 按实例 ID 分页查询写入（含发布）报告的 Workflow 列表明细，支持按 Workflow 名称筛选

GetBwmMigrationWorkflowSubmitStart.description_en: Starts a schedule import (write) task by task ID to batch import converted workflows into the destination scheduling system
GetBwmMigrationWorkflowSubmitStart.description_zh: 按任务 ID 启动调度导入（写入）任务，将转换后的工作流批量导入目标端调度系统

GetCronExecTime.description_en: Calculates and returns the next 5 execute times based on a Cron expression, allowing you to verify that a validation rule is correct before configuring a scheduled data validation task. This is a general-purpose operation that does not require authentication
GetCronExecTime.description_zh: 依据 Cron 表达式计算并返回后续 5 次执行时间，用于配置定时校验前验证规则是否正确；通用接口，无需鉴权

GetDataCheckConfig.description_en: Queries the table detail configurations of a data validation task by task ID, and returns the tables to be validated, validation scope, and comparison rules
GetDataCheckConfig.description_zh: 按校验任务 ID 查询其表明细配置，返回待校验表、校验范围与比对规则

GetDataCheckReportOverview.description_en: Queries the overview of a data validation report by validation batch, and returns summary metrics such as the number of validated tables, passed tables, and pass rate
GetDataCheckReportOverview.description_zh: 按校验批次查询报告概览，返回校验表数量、通过表数量、通过率等汇总指标

GetDataCheckReportStatus.description_en: Queries the generation status (not generated, generating, or generated) and generation information of a report for a specified validation batch
GetDataCheckReportStatus.description_zh: 查询指定校验批次报告的生成状态（未生成、生成中、已生成）及报告生成信息

GetDataCheckTaskConfig.description_en: Queries the complete configuration of a data validation task by task ID, including data sources, validation type, and scheduling settings
GetDataCheckTaskConfig.description_zh: 按校验任务 ID 查看任务的完整配置信息，包含数据源、校验类型与调度设置

GetDataCheckTaskList.description_en: Lists data validation tasks by condition with paging, with support for filtering by task name, data source, and other dimensions
GetDataCheckTaskList.description_zh: 按条件分页查询数据校验任务列表，支持按任务名称、数据源等维度筛选

GetDataCheckTemplate.description_en: Queries the detailed configuration of a metric check template by template ID and returns the metric definitions included in the template
GetDataCheckTemplate.description_zh: 按模版 ID 查询指标校验模版的详细配置，返回模版包含的指标定义

GetDataCheckTemplateList.description_en: Queries a list of data validation templates with paging. Supports filtering by check type, template name, and whether the template is built-in. General node templates can be downloaded without authentication
GetDataCheckTemplateList.description_zh: 分页查询数据校验模板列表，支持按校验类型、模板名称、是否内置筛选；通用任务模板下载，无需鉴权

GetInnerConvertAsyncResult.description_en: Queries the asynchronous execution result of a workflow conversion by submit credential. This is a Skill internal operation
GetInnerConvertAsyncResult.description_zh: Skill 内部接口，按提交凭据查询工作流转换的异步执行结果

GetInnerReadAsyncResult.description_en: Queries the asynchronous execution result of a source workflow read operation by submit credential. This is a Skill internal operation
GetInnerReadAsyncResult.description_zh: Skill 内部接口，按提交凭据查询源端工作流读取的异步执行结果

GetLhmAgentStatus.description_en: Queries the registration and running status of a user-side Agent by agent type and skill name to determine whether the local environment is ready
GetLhmAgentStatus.description_zh: 按 Agent 类型与 Skill 名称查询用户侧 Agent 的注册与运行状态，用于判断本地环境是否就绪

GetLhmDWResourceGroupStatus.description_en: Queries the status of a user's DataWorks resource groups by region to determine whether available execution resources exist for migration tasks
GetLhmDWResourceGroupStatus.description_zh: 按地域查询用户 DataWorks 资源组的状态，用于判断迁移任务是否具备可用的执行资源

GetMetaOssTempKey.description_en: Retrieves temporary OSS upload credentials (STS), including the AccessKey, security token, bucket, upload directory, and expiration time
GetMetaOssTempKey.description_zh: 获取上传文件所需的 OSS 临时授权凭证（STS），返回 AccessKey、安全令牌、Bucket、上传目录与过期时间等参数

GetSqlConversionProgress.description_en: Queries the execution progress of an SQL conversion task by task ID and returns the total count, completed count, success count, and completion percentage
GetSqlConversionProgress.description_zh: 按任务 ID 查询 SQL 转换任务的执行进度，返回总数、完成数、成功数与完成百分比

GetSqlConversionResult.description_en: Queries the result details of an SQL conversion task and returns the source statement, target statement, and conversion status of each SQL statement
GetSqlConversionResult.description_zh: 查询 SQL 转换任务的结果明细，返回每条 SQL 的源语句、目标语句与转换状态

GetSqlTableLineage.description_en: Parses table-level lineage from a single SQL script and returns the names of upstream and downstream tables referenced by the script
GetSqlTableLineage.description_zh: 解析单条 SQL 脚本的表级血缘，返回脚本引用的上游表与下游表名称

GetStepResultOverview.description_en: Queries the step-level result overview by validation result ID to determine the overall pass status of a single validation step
GetStepResultOverview.description_zh: 按校验结果 ID 查询 step 维度的结果概览，用于定位单个校验步骤的整体通过情况

ListDataCheckColumnResults.description_en: Queries field (column) dimension validation details by validation result ID with paging, and returns the comparison results and threshold evaluation for each field between the source and destination
ListDataCheckColumnResults.description_zh: 按校验结果 ID 分页查询字段（列）维度的校验明细，返回每个字段的源端与目标端比对结果及阈值判定

ListDataCheckConfig.description_en: Queries the table-level configuration list of a data validation node by node ID and source table name with paging
ListDataCheckConfig.description_zh: 按校验任务 ID 与源表名分页查询表明细配置列表

ListDataCheckReport.description_en: Queries a validation report by paged query, returning job dimension summaries and validation result details for each table within the job
ListDataCheckReport.description_zh: 分页查询校验报告，返回 job 维度汇总及其下各表的校验结果明细

ListDataCheckReportInstance.description_en: Queries the list of historical check instances by check task ID to trace the check results of each scheduling run
ListDataCheckReportInstance.description_zh: 按校验任务 ID 查询历史校验实例列表，用于回溯每次调度的校验结果

ListDataCheckReportStep.description_en: Queries step-level (partition-level) verification details by job ID with a paged query. Supports filtering by verification result and node status
ListDataCheckReportStep.description_zh: 按 job ID 分页查询 step（分区）维度的校验明细，支持按校验结果与任务状态筛选

ListDataCheckReportStepByJobId.description_en: Queries a paged list of step (partition) dimension verification details by a UUID-format job ID with paging support
ListDataCheckReportStepByJobId.description_zh: 按 UUID 形式的 job ID 分页查询 step（分区）维度的校验明细列表

ListDataCheckTaskHistory.description_en: Queries historical instances of data validation nodes by batch ID and node ID with paging. Supports filtering by execute status, validation result, and time ranges for creation, execute start, and execute end
ListDataCheckTaskHistory.description_zh: 按批次与任务 ID 分页查询校验任务历史实例，支持按执行状态、校验结果及创建、执行、完成时间区间筛选

ListMetaDataComponentPage.description_en: Queries the metadata data source list by paging and returns the data source type, connection status, and status information of associated profiling nodes
ListMetaDataComponentPage.description_zh: 分页查询元数据数据源列表，返回数据源类型、连接状态及关联探查任务的状态信息

PostInnerConvert.description_zh: 用于将源数据源的SQL语句转换为目标数据源对应的SQL语句

PostInnerReader.description_en: Submits a source workflow read task for a Skill internal operation and returns an asynchronous execution credential. Query the result by calling GetInnerReadAsyncResult
PostInnerReader.description_zh: Skill 内部接口，提交源端工作流读取任务并返回异步执行凭据，结果通过 GetInnerReadAsyncResult 查询

PostInnerUploadConvertPackage.description_en: Uploads a local conversion result package for subsequent batch writing to the destination scheduling system. This is a Skill internal operation
PostInnerUploadConvertPackage.description_zh: Skill 内部接口，上传本地转换结果包，供后续批量写入目标端调度系统

SingleSqlDryRun.description_en: Performs a Dry Run validation on a single converted SQL statement to verify syntax and execution permissions without actually writing data
SingleSqlDryRun.description_zh: 对单条转换后的 SQL 执行 Dry Run 校验，在不实际写入数据的前提下验证语法与执行权限

SyntaxCheckAndTransformSqlConversionTask.description_en: Validates the syntax of a specified SQL conversion task and then performs the conversion, returning the combined validation and conversion results
SyntaxCheckAndTransformSqlConversionTask.description_zh: 对指定 SQL 转换任务先做语法校验再执行转换，返回校验与转换的综合结果

UpdateDataCheckTask.description_en: Modifies an existing data validation task. You can adjust the basic task information, source and destination data sources, validation engines, and the referenced validation template
UpdateDataCheckTask.description_zh: 修改已存在的数据校验任务，可调整任务基本信息、源端与目标端数据源、校验引擎及所引用的校验模板

UpdateDataCheckTemplate.description_en: Updates the name and metric definitions of a metric check template. After the update, nodes that reference this template execute based on the new definitions
UpdateDataCheckTemplate.description_zh: 更新指标校验模版的名称与指标定义，变更后引用该模版的任务按新定义执行
